us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: 25 states sue Trump administration over new tariffs
bullets: Twenty-five states challenged the latest Trump tariffs in court.
The lawsuit says the tariffs are a pretext to replace levies struck down by the Supreme Court.
The White House says the tariffs use lawful Section 301 authority tied to forced-labor imports.

articles.title: US markets set to rise as oil drops after Trump criticizes Big Oil
bullets: US stock futures pointed higher early Tuesday.
Oil prices fell sharply after Trump criticized energy companies’ profits.
ExxonMobil, ConocoPhillips and Chevron shares fell before the opening bell.

articles.title: Trump calls new Iran talks the ‘last chance’ to avoid escalation
bullets: Trump said new talks with Tehran would focus first on reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
He said he held off on major new US strikes after appeals from Gulf allies.
The president said denuclearization would be a later phase of any deal.

articles.title: Trump’s latest tariff fight expands after earlier business lawsuits
bullets: Small businesses had already sued over the new tariff program.
The broader state lawsuit adds pressure on the administration’s trade strategy.
The legal fight centers on whether the government met Section 301 requirements.

articles.title: AP-NORC poll shows most Americans say Iran war not worth fighting
bullets: An AP-NORC poll found broad public skepticism about the Iran war.
Trump’s approval on Iran slipped from the prior month.
Only about 2 in 10 US adults favored continued military action.

articles.title: Gaza transition envoy meets Netanyahu on Hamas disarmament plan
bullets: A Board of Peace official met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
The talks focused partly on a Gaza disarmament deal with Hamas.
The envoy also urged Israel to halt strikes in Gaza.

articles.title: Israel raises concerns over Gaza disarmament deal
bullets: Israel said it had serious concerns about the Hamas disarmament framework.
US officials said Israel had been consulted during negotiations.
The plan remains politically difficult for Netanyahu’s government.

articles.title: US-Iran talks aim to reopen Strait of Hormuz
bullets: Trump said renewed talks could help restart normal shipping through Hormuz.
The strait is a critical route for global oil and gas trade.
Iranian officials publicly disputed parts of Trump’s account of the talks.

articles.title: Trump’s repeated Iran strike pauses face scrutiny
bullets: Trump again said he was halting planned attacks while talks proceed.
AP reviewed prior moments when strike pauses were followed by renewed fighting.
The war has affected oil prices and shipping through the Gulf.

articles.title: Full text released for Hamas disarmament and Israeli withdrawal roadmap
bullets: The published text lays out phased implementation of the Gaza plan.
It calls for Hamas disarmament and eventual Israeli withdrawal.
The framework references monitoring by a Board of Peace-linked mechanism.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories and India-focused developments

articles.title: India’s Gen Z ‘Cockroach’ movement dents Modi’s political image
bullets: Youth protesters forced the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan.
The movement began over exam paper leaks and broadened into accountability demands.
Analysts said the protests challenged Modi’s image of political invulnerability.

articles.title: Indian Parliament monsoon session focuses on exams and MSMEs
bullets: NDTV reported key bills on public examinations and MSMEs were on Parliament’s agenda.
The agenda follows weeks of public anger over exam paper leaks.
The session comes amid heightened scrutiny of education governance.

articles.title: Assam flood situation improves but lakhs remain affected
bullets: NDTV reported no fresh flood deaths in Assam in the latest official update.
About 4.45 lakh people remained affected across six districts.
The report said the flood situation improved marginally.

articles.title: Centre approves new rail lines on Karnataka-Andhra route
bullets: NDTV listed approval for third and fourth rail lines on a key route.
The project concerns connectivity between Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh.
The approval was carried by Press Trust of India on NDTV.

articles.title: 8th Pay Commission talks restart with August meetings planned
bullets: NDTV reported fresh August meeting dates for 8th Pay Commission talks.
The process is closely watched by central government employees and pensioners.
The update appeared among NDTV’s top national stories.

articles.title: ExxonMobil slips premarket as oil prices fall
bullets: ExxonMobil shares fell about 1% before the bell.
The move followed a drop of nearly 3% in oil prices.
Trump criticized major oil companies for high profits during the Iran conflict.

articles.title: Chevron falls after Trump criticizes energy-company profits
bullets: Chevron shares were lower in premarket trading.
Trump singled out Chevron and ExxonMobil while urging lower retail prices.
The pullback came as crude prices reversed into losses.

articles.title: ConocoPhillips joins energy-stock pullback
bullets: ConocoPhillips fell around 1% before the open.
Energy stocks were pressured by lower crude prices.
Investors also watched renewed US-Iran talks over the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Dow futures jump as Wall Street looks higher
bullets: Dow Jones Industrial Average futures rose about 1.2%.
The broader market was helped by easing oil-price pressure.
Investors watched Iran diplomacy and tariff litigation.

articles.title: Nasdaq futures rise as tech sentiment improves premarket
bullets: Nasdaq futures gained about 1.1% early Tuesday.
The move came alongside higher S&P 500 futures.
Lower oil prices helped ease inflation concerns for investors.

articles.title: States’ tariff lawsuit raises stakes for importers and retailers
bullets: The new lawsuit targets tariffs covering countries that supply most US imports.
Importers face uncertainty while litigation proceeds.
The administration says the levies address forced-labor enforcement abroad.

articles.title: Small businesses challenge Trump’s new sweeping tariffs
bullets: Two lawsuits by small businesses preceded the states’ challenge.
Plaintiffs argue the government did not meet Section 301 requirements.
The White House’s tariff strategy faces multiple legal tests.

articles.title: Energy companies come under White House pressure over prices
bullets: Trump said oil companies had made too much money during the Iran conflict.
He urged companies to cut retail prices.
Energy shares fell as crude prices slid.

articles.title: Tariff uncertainty remains central issue for US companies
bullets: Trump’s new tariffs took effect after temporary global tariffs expired.
The administration shifted to Section 301 after an earlier Supreme Court defeat.
Businesses are weighing legal risk, import costs and supply-chain impacts.

articles.title: Shipping and energy markets watch US-Iran diplomacy
bullets: Talks over the Strait of Hormuz could affect global oil and gas flows.
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said there was a chance of a deal soon.
Oil prices fell as investors assessed the diplomatic opening.

articles.title: xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin leaves Elon Musk’s AI company
bullets: Babuschkin announced he had left xAI.
He said he planned to launch an AI-safety-focused investment firm.
The exit added to scrutiny of leadership turnover at Musk’s AI startup.

articles.title: Big US companies expand AI use in workplace efficiency drives
bullets: CNBC examined how major companies are using AI tools internally.
Reported use cases include customer service, software development and supply-chain operations.
Some companies frame AI as productivity support rather than direct job replacement.

articles.title: Google faces renewed Chrome and search antitrust pressure
bullets: CNBC reported on possible remedies in Google’s search antitrust case.
Potential outcomes include limits on search-distribution payments.
Analysts debated whether Chrome-related remedies would materially change competition.

articles.title: Trump AI order creates voluntary national-security review process
bullets: The order invites frontier AI labs to share advanced models for review.
The review window is limited to up to 30 days before public release.
OpenAI, Anthropic and Google were among companies referenced in the policy discussion.

articles.title: White House urges light-touch federal AI regulation
bullets: The White House blueprint asks Congress to preempt burdensome state AI laws.
The plan emphasizes innovation, child safety, electricity costs and copyright issues.
State officials and AI safety advocates remain divided over the approach.
